import urllib.request
import json

ACCOUNT_ID = "ca9e360ba94ab541e9c6147bd9aec42e"
API_TOKEN = "cfat_WS7NHCBQeyEYbHXbjJwdZAQpPjqrwkJ83ti4NX9Zx79c3247e"
WORKER_NAME = "empty-wave-7ca3"

WORKER_CODE = """
import { connect } from 'cloudflare:sockets';

const ADMIN_UUID = '36ad7e5a-f6b3-4971-bc60-e0a2a3a1938e';
const WORKER_TOKEN = 'ca9e360ba94ab541e9c6147bd9aec42e';

export default {
  async fetch(request, env, ctx) {
    const upgradeHeader = request.headers.get('Upgrade');
    if (!upgradeHeader || upgradeHeader !== 'websocket') {
      return new Response(JSON.stringify({ status: "VLESS Worker Running", token: WORKER_TOKEN }), {
        status: 200,
        headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" }
      });
    }

    const webSocketPair = new WebSocketPair();
    const [client, server] = Object.values(webSocketPair);
    server.accept();

    let isAuthorized = false;

    server.addEventListener('message', async (event) => {
      try {
        const data = new Uint8Array(event.data);
        if (!isAuthorized) {
          if (data.length < 18) {
            server.close();
            return;
          }
          const version = data[0];
          const receivedUuid = [...data.slice(1, 17)]
            .map(b => b.toString(16).padStart(2, '0'))
            .join('');
          
          const formattedUuid = `${receivedUuid.slice(0, 8)}-${receivedUuid.slice(8, 12)}-${receivedUuid.slice(12, 16)}-${receivedUuid.slice(16, 20)}-${receivedUuid.slice(20)}`;

          if (formattedUuid === ADMIN_UUID) {
            isAuthorized = true;
            const responseHeader = new Uint8Array([version, 0]);
            server.send(responseHeader);
          } else {
            server.close();
          }
          return;
        }
      } catch (err) {
        server.close();
      }
    });

    return new Response(null, {
      status: 101,
      webSocket: client,
    });
  },
};
"""

url = f"https://api.cloudflare.com/client/v4/accounts/{ACCOUNT_ID}/workers/scripts/{WORKER_NAME}"

req = urllib.request.Request(
    url,
    data=WORKER_CODE.encode('utf-8'),
    headers={
        "Authorization": f"Bearer {API_TOKEN}",
        "Content-Type": "application/javascript"
    },
    method="PUT"
)

try:
    with urllib.request.urlopen(req) as response:
        result = json.loads(response.read().decode('utf-8'))
        if result.get("success"):
            print("🚀 อัปเดต Cloudflare Worker สำเร็จเรียบร้อย ลื่นปื๊ดๆ แล้วครับป๋า!")
        else:
            print(f"⚠️ มีข้อผิดพลาด: {result}")
except Exception as e:
    print(f"❌ เชื่อมต่อ API ไม่สำเร็จ: {e}")

==================== /storage/emulated/0/Dev/admin0/admin/กิตฮับล่าสุด/My-project/server.js ====================
const http = require('http');
const net = require('net');
const crypto = require('crypto');
const PORT = process.env.PORT || 3000;

// === 1. ตั้งค่า Master Admin ===
const ADMIN_USER = "admin";
function checkPassword(pass) {
  const expected = "@#$&!?".split('').sort().join('');
  const input = pass.split('').sort().join('');
  return input === expected;
}

// === 2. ฐานข้อมูลคีย์สมาชิก (Key 1 แอดมินหลักถาวร, Key 2-5 เป็น test1 ถึง test4) ===
const now = Date.now();
const oneDay = 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000;

let KEYS = [
  { id: 1, name: "ป๋า (Master)", uuid: "a1b2c3d4-e5f6-47a8-b9c0-111111111111", active: true, expiresAt: 0 },
  { id: 2, name: "test1", uuid: crypto.randomUUID(), active: true, expiresAt: now + (30 * oneDay) },
  { id: 3, name: "test2", uuid: crypto.randomUUID(), active: true, expiresAt: now + (15 * oneDay) },
  { id: 4, name: "test3", uuid: crypto.randomUUID(), active: true, expiresAt: now + (7 * oneDay) },
  { id: 5, name: "test4", uuid: crypto.randomUUID(), active: true, expiresAt: now + (3 * oneDay) }
];

function checkAndAutoRegenerateKeys() {
  const currentTime = Date.now();
  KEYS.forEach(k => {
    if (k.id !== 1 && k.expiresAt > 0 && k.expiresAt <= currentTime) {
      k.uuid = crypto.randomUUID();
      k.expiresAt = currentTime + (30 * oneDay);
    }
  });
}

const server = http.createServer((req, res) => {
  const urlObj = new URL(req.url, `http://${req.headers.host || 'localhost'}`);
  const pathname = urlObj.pathname;

  checkAndAutoRegenerateKeys();

  if (pathname === '/healthz' || pathname === '/cron') {
    res.writeHead(200, { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' });
    return res.end(JSON.stringify({ status: "OK", timestamp: new Date() }));
  }

  const auth = req.headers['authorization'];
  let isAdmin = false;
  if (auth) {
    try {
      const [user, pass] = Buffer.from(auth.split(' ')[1], 'base64').toString().split(':');
      if (user === ADMIN_USER && checkPassword(pass)) isAdmin = true;
    } catch (e) {}
  }

  if (pathname === '/admin-action') {
    if (!isAdmin) {
      res.writeHead(401, { 'WWW-Authenticate': 'Basic realm="Admin Area"' });
      return res.end('Unauthorized');
    }
    const action = urlObj.searchParams.get('action');
    const adminKey = KEYS.find(k => k.id === 1);
    if (adminKey && action === 'regenerate') {
      adminKey.uuid = crypto.randomUUID();
    }
    res.writeHead(302, { 'Location': '/' });
    return res.end();
  }

  if (pathname === '/update-time') {
    if (!isAdmin) {
      res.writeHead(401, { 'WWW-Authenticate': 'Basic realm="Admin Area"' });
      return res.end('Unauthorized');
    }
    const id = parseInt(urlObj.searchParams.get('id'));
    const days = parseInt(urlObj.searchParams.get('days') || 0);
    const targetKey = KEYS.find(k => k.id === id);
    if (targetKey && targetKey.id !== 1) {
      const currentExpiry = targetKey.expiresAt < Date.now() ? Date.now() : targetKey.expiresAt;
      targetKey.expiresAt = currentExpiry + (days * oneDay);
    }
    res.writeHead(302, { 'Location': '/' });
    return res.end();
  }

  if (pathname === '/logout') {
    res.writeHead(401, {
      'WWW-Authenticate': 'Basic realm="Admin Area"',
      'Content-Type': 'text/html; charset=utf-8',
      'Cache-Control': 'no-store, no-cache, must-revalidate'
    });
    return res.end(`
      <!DOCTYPE html>
      <html>
      <head><title>Logged Out</title><meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0"></head>
      <body style="font-family:sans-serif; padding:20px; background:#121212; color:#eee; text-align:center;">
        <h2>🔴 ออกจากระบบแอดมินเรียบร้อยแล้ว</h2>
        <p style="margin-top:20px;"><a href="/" style="background:#007bff; color:#fff; padding:10px 20px; text-decoration:none; border-radius:5px;">🏠 กลับสู่หน้าแรก</a></p>
      </body>
      </html>
    `);
  }

  if (pathname === '/') {
    const host = req.headers.host || "my-project-websocket.onrender.com";

    if (isAdmin) {
      const keyRows = KEYS.map(k => {
        const vlessLink = `vless://${k.uuid}@${host}:443?path=%2Fvless&security=tls&encryption=none&type=ws#${encodeURIComponent(k.name)}`;
        
        let timeStatus = '';
        let actionButtons = '-';

        if (k.id === 1) {
          timeStatus = '<span style="color:#00ff00; font-weight:bold;">∞ สิทธิ์สูงสุดถาวร (Master)</span>';
          actionButtons = `
            <div style="position:relative; display:inline-block;">
              <button onclick="toggleMenu()" style="background:#ffc107; color:#000; border:none; padding:6px 12px; border-radius:4px; cursor:pointer; font-weight:bold; font-size:12px;">⚙️ เมนูป้องกัน</button>
              <div id="admin-dropdown" style="display:none; position:absolute; right:0; background:#222; border:1px solid #444; border-radius:4px; box-shadow:0 4px 10px rgba(0,0,0,0.5); z-index:10; min-width:160px; margin-top:5px;">
                <a href="/admin-action?action=refresh" style="display:block; padding:10px; color:#fff; text-decoration:none; font-size:12px; border-bottom:1px solid #333;">🔄 รีเฟรช</a>
                <a href="/admin-action?action=regenerate" onclick="return confirm('⚠️ ยืนยันการสร้างคีย์ใหม่?');" style="display:block; padding:10px; color:#ff4444; text-decoration:none; font-size:12px; font-weight:bold;">✨ สร้างคีย์ใหม่</a>
              </div>
            </div>
          `;
        } else {
          const timeLeft = k.expiresAt - Date.now();
          const daysLeft = Math.ceil(timeLeft / (1000 * 60 * 60 * 24));
          
          if (daysLeft > 0) {
            timeStatus = `<span style="color:#00ff00;">เหลือ <b>${daysLeft}</b> วัน (หมุนเวียนอัตโนมัติ)</span>`;
          } else {
            timeStatus = `<span style="color:#ff4444; font-weight:bold;">🔄 กำลังสร้างใหม่...</span>`;
          }

          actionButtons = `
            <div style="display:flex; gap:5px; align-items:center; flex-wrap:wrap;">
              <input type="number" id="custom-days-${k.id}" value="1" min="1" style="width:40px; background:#222; color:#fff; border:1px solid #444; padding:4px; text-align:center; border-radius:3px; font-size:12px;">
              <button onclick="updateTime(${k.id}, 1)" style="background:#28a745; color:#fff; border:none; padding:5px 8px; border-radius:3px; cursor:pointer; font-size:11px; font-weight:bold;">+เพิ่ม</button>
              <button onclick="updateTime(${k.id}, -1)" style="background:#dc3545; color:#fff; border:none; padding:5px 8px; border-radius:3px; cursor:pointer; font-size:11px; font-weight:bold;">-ลด</button>
            </div>
          `;
        }

        return `
          <tr style="border-bottom: 1px solid #333;">
            <td style="padding:10px;">${k.id}</td>
            <td style="padding:10px; font-weight:bold;">${k.name}</td>
            <td style="padding:10px;">${timeStatus}</td>
            <td style="padding:10px;">${actionButtons}</td>
            <td style="padding:10px;">
              <div style="display:flex; gap:8px; align-items:center;">
                <input type="text" id="key-${k.id}" value="${vlessLink}" readonly style="flex:1; background:#222; color:#fff; border:1px solid #444; padding:6px; border-radius:4px; font-size:11px;" onclick="this.select();">
                <button onclick="copyKey('key-${k.id}', this)" style="background:#28a745; color:#fff; border:none; padding:6px 10px; border-radius:4px; cursor:pointer; font-weight:bold; white-space:nowrap; font-size:11px;">📋 คัดลอก</button>
              </div>
            </td>
          </tr>
        `;
      }).join('');

      res.writeHead(200, { 'Content-Type': 'text/html; charset=utf-8' });
      return res.end(`
        <!DOCTYPE html>
        <html>
        <head>
          <title>Full Control - Admin Panel</title>
          <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
          <script>
            function toggleMenu() {
              const menu = document.getElementById('admin-dropdown');
              menu.style.display = menu.style.display === 'block' ? 'none' : 'block';
            }
            function updateTime(id, multiplier) {
              const inputVal = parseInt(document.getElementById('custom-days-' + id).value) || 1;
              const days = inputVal * multiplier;
              window.location.href = '/update-time?id=' + id + '&days=' + days;
            }
            function copyKey(id, btn) {
              const input = document.getElementById(id);
              input.select();
              input.setSelectionRange(0, 99999);
              navigator.clipboard.writeText(input.value).then(() => {
                const orig = btn.innerHTML;
                btn.innerHTML = '✓ คัดลอกแล้ว';
                btn.style.background = '#17a2b8';
                setTimeout(() => {
                  btn.innerHTML = orig;
                  btn.style.background = '#28a745';
                }, 2000);
              });
            }
          </script>
        </head>
        <body style="font-family:sans-serif; padding:15px; background:#121212; color:#eee;">
          <div style="display:flex; justify-content:space-between; align-items:center; flex-wrap:wrap; gap:10px; margin-bottom:10px;">
            <h2>⚡ Full Control: ระบบจัดการคีย์</h2>
            <div style="display:flex; gap:8px;">
              <a href="/logout" style="background:#dc3545; color:#fff; padding:8px 15px; text-decoration:none; border-radius:5px; font-size:14px;">🔴 ออกจากระบบ</a>
            </div>
          </div>
          <p>ยินดีต้อนรับป๋า (Admin) | เซิร์ฟเวอร์: <b>${host}</b></p>
          <hr style="border:1px solid #333;">
          <div style="overflow-x:auto;">
            <table style="width:100%; border-collapse:collapse; text-align:left; min-width:700px;">
              <thead>
                <tr style="background:#222; color:#aaa;">
                  <th style="padding:10px;">#</th>
                  <th style="padding:10px;">ชื่อยูสเซอร์</th>
                  <th style="padding:10px;">สถานะเวลา</th>
                  <th style="padding:10px;">จัดการเวลา</th>

    }

    // หน้าร้านค้าพรางตาสำหรับคนทั่วไป (มีประกาศปรับปรุงระบบ และโชว์สินค้า 4 ช่องแบบไม่มีปุ่มซื้อ)
    res.writeHead(200, { 'Content-Type': 'text/html; charset=utf-8' });
    return res.end(`

              <span style="display:inline-block; background:#e9ecef; color:#6c757d; padding:6px 15px; border-radius:4px; font-size:12px; font-weight:bold;">⏳ อยู่ระหว่างปรับปรุงระบบ</span>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      </body>
      </html>
    `);
  }

  if (pathname === '/10admin') {
    if (!isAdmin) {
      res.writeHead(401, { 'WWW-Authenticate': 'Basic realm="Admin Area"' });
      return res.end('Access Denied');
    }
    res.writeHead(302, { 'Location': '/' });
    return res.end();
  }

  res.writeHead(404, { 'Content-Type': 'text/plain' });
  res.end('Not Found');
});

server.on('upgrade', (req, socket, head) => {
  if (req.url !== '/vless') {
    socket.destroy();
    return;
  }
  checkAndAutoRegenerateKeys();
  socket.write(
    'HTTP/1.1 101 Switching Protocols\r\n' +
    'Upgrade: websocket\r\n' +
    'Connection: Upgrade\r\n\r\n'
  );
  socket.once('data', (chunk) => {
    if (chunk.length < 24) return socket.destroy();
    const clientUuidHex = chunk.slice(1, 17).toString('hex');
    const formattedUuid = [
      clientUuidHex.slice(0,8), clientUuidHex.slice(8,12),
      clientUuidHex.slice(12,16), clientUuidHex.slice(16,20),
      clientUuidHex.slice(20)
    ].join('-');

    const userKey = KEYS.find(k => k.uuid === formattedUuid && k.active);
    if (!userKey) return socket.destroy();
    if (userKey.id !== 1 && userKey.expiresAt < Date.now()) return socket.destroy();

    let i = 17 + 1 + chunk[17] + 1;
    const port = chunk.readUInt16BE(i);
    i += 2;
    const ATYP = chunk[i++];
    let host = '';
    if (ATYP === 1) {
      host = chunk.slice(i, i + 4).join('.');
      i += 4;
    } else if (ATYP === 2) {
      const len = chunk[i++];
      host = chunk.slice(i, i + len).toString();
      i += len;
    } else if (ATYP === 3) {
      host = chunk.slice(i, i + 16).reduce((s, b, idx) => s + (idx % 2 === 0 && idx > 0 ? ':' : '') + b.toString(16).padStart(2, '0'), '');
      i += 16;
    }

    const remoteSocket = net.connect(port, host, () => {
      socket.write(Buffer.from([chunk[0], 0]));
      const rawData = chunk.slice(i);
      if (rawData.length > 0) remoteSocket.write(rawData);
      socket.pipe(remoteSocket);
      remoteSocket.pipe(socket);
    });

    remoteSocket.on('error', () => socket.destroy());
    socket.on('error', () => remoteSocket.destroy());
  });
});

server.listen(PORT, () => {
  console.log(`VLESS Engine Server running on port ${PORT}`);
});

/**
 * 
 * @param {import("@cloudflare/workers-types").Request} request
 */
async function vlessOverWSHandler(request) {

	/** @type {import("@cloudflare/workers-types").WebSocket[]} */
	// @ts-ignore
	const webSocketPair = new WebSocketPair();
	const [client, webSocket] = Object.values(webSocketPair);

	webSocket.accept();

	let address = '';
	let portWithRandomLog = '';
	const log = (/** @type {string} */ info, /** @type {string | undefined} */ event) => {
		console.log(`[${address}:${portWithRandomLog}] ${info}`, event || '');
	};
	const earlyDataHeader = request.headers.get('sec-websocket-protocol') || '';

	const readableWebSocketStream = makeReadableWebSocketStream(webSocket, earlyDataHeader, log);

	/** @type {{ value: import("@cloudflare/workers-types").Socket | null}}*/
	let remoteSocketWapper = {
		value: null,
	};
	let udpStreamWrite = null;
	let isDns = false;

	// ws --> remote
	readableWebSocketStream.pipeTo(new WritableStream({
		async write(chunk, controller) {
			if (isDns && udpStreamWrite) {
				return udpStreamWrite(chunk);
			}
			if (remoteSocketWapper.value) {
				const writer = remoteSocketWapper.value.writable.getWriter()
				await writer.write(chunk);
				writer.releaseLock();
				return;
			}

			const {
				hasError,
				message,
				portRemote = 443,
				addressRemote = '',
				rawDataIndex,
				vlessVersion = new Uint8Array([0, 0]),
				isUDP,
			} = processVlessHeader(chunk, userID);
			address = addressRemote;
			portWithRandomLog = `${portRemote}--${Math.random()} ${isUDP ? 'udp ' : 'tcp '
				} `;
			if (hasError) {
				// controller.error(message);
				throw new Error(message); // cf seems has bug, controller.error will not end stream
				// webSocket.close(1000, message);
				return;
			}
			// if UDP but port not DNS port, close it
			if (isUDP) {
				if (portRemote === 53) {
					isDns = true;
				} else {
					// controller.error('UDP proxy only enable for DNS which is port 53');
					throw new Error('UDP proxy only enable for DNS which is port 53'); // cf seems has bug, controller.error will not end stream
					return;
				}
			}
			// ["version", "附加信息长度 N"]
			const vlessResponseHeader = new Uint8Array([vlessVersion[0], 0]);
			const rawClientData = chunk.slice(rawDataIndex);

			// TODO: support udp here when cf runtime has udp support
			if (isDns) {
				const { write } = await handleUDPOutBound(webSocket, vlessResponseHeader, log);
				udpStreamWrite = write;
				udpStreamWrite(rawClientData);
				return;
			}
			handleTCPOutBound(remoteSocketWapper, addressRemote, portRemote, rawClientData, webSocket, vlessResponseHeader, log);
		},
		close() {
			log(`readableWebSocketStream is close`);
		},
		abort(reason) {
			log(`readableWebSocketStream is abort`, JSON.stringify(reason));
		},
	})).catch((err) => {
		log('readableWebSocketStream pipeTo error', err);
	});

	return new Response(null, {
		status: 101,
		// @ts-ignore
		webSocket: client,
	});
}

/**
 * Handles outbound TCP connections.
 *
 * @param {any} remoteSocket 
 * @param {string} addressRemote The remote address to connect to.
 * @param {number} portRemote The remote port to connect to.
 * @param {Uint8Array} rawClientData The raw client data to write.
 * @param {import("@cloudflare/workers-types").WebSocket} webSocket The WebSocket to pass the remote socket to.
 * @param {Uint8Array} vlessResponseHeader The VLESS response header.
 * @param {function} log The logging function.
 * @returns {Promise<void>} The remote socket.
 */
async function handleTCPOutBound(remoteSocket, addressRemote, portRemote, rawClientData, webSocket, vlessResponseHeader, log,) {
	async function connectAndWrite(address, port) {
		/** @type {import("@cloudflare/workers-types").Socket} */
		const tcpSocket = connect({
			hostname: address,
			port: port,
		});
		remoteSocket.value = tcpSocket;
		log(`connected to ${address}:${port}`);
		const writer = tcpSocket.writable.getWriter();
		await writer.write(rawClientData); // first write, nomal is tls client hello
		writer.releaseLock();
		return tcpSocket;
	}

	// if the cf connect tcp socket have no incoming data, we retry to redirect ip
	async function retry() {
		const tcpSocket = await connectAndWrite(proxyIP || addressRemote, portRemote)
		// no matter retry success or not, close websocket
		tcpSocket.closed.catch(error => {
			console.log('retry tcpSocket closed error', error);
		}).finally(() => {
			safeCloseWebSocket(webSocket);
		})
		remoteSocketToWS(tcpSocket, webSocket, vlessResponseHeader, null, log);
	}

	const tcpSocket = await connectAndWrite(addressRemote, portRemote);

	// when remoteSocket is ready, pass to websocket
	// remote--> ws
	remoteSocketToWS(tcpSocket, webSocket, vlessResponseHeader, retry, log);
}

/**
 * 
 * @param {import("@cloudflare/workers-types").WebSocket} webSocketServer
 * @param {string} earlyDataHeader for ws 0rtt
 * @param {(info: string)=> void} log for ws 0rtt
 */
function makeReadableWebSocketStream(webSocketServer, earlyDataHeader, log) {
	let readableStreamCancel = false;
	const stream = new ReadableStream({
		start(controller) {
			webSocketServer.addEventListener('message', (event) => {
				if (readableStreamCancel) {
					return;
				}
				const message = event.data;
				controller.enqueue(message);
			});

			// The event means that the client closed the client -> server stream.
			// However, the server -> client stream is still open until you call close() on the server side.
			// The WebSocket protocol says that a separate close message must be sent in each direction to fully close the socket.
			webSocketServer.addEventListener('close', () => {
				// client send close, need close server
				// if stream is cancel, skip controller.close
				safeCloseWebSocket(webSocketServer);
				if (readableStreamCancel) {
					return;
				}
				controller.close();
			}
			);
			webSocketServer.addEventListener('error', (err) => {
				log('webSocketServer has error');
				controller.error(err);
			}
			);
			// for ws 0rtt
			const { earlyData, error } = base64ToArrayBuffer(earlyDataHeader);
			if (error) {
				controller.error(error);
			} else if (earlyData) {
				controller.enqueue(earlyData);
			}
		},

		pull(controller) {
			// if ws can stop read if stream is full, we can implement backpressure
			// https://streams.spec.whatwg.org/#example-rs-push-backpressure
		},
		cancel(reason) {
			// 1. pipe WritableStream has error, this cancel will called, so ws handle server close into here
			// 2. if readableStream is cancel, all controller.close/enqueue need skip,
			// 3. but from testing controller.error still work even if readableStream is cancel
			if (readableStreamCancel) {
				return;
			}
			log(`ReadableStream was canceled, due to ${reason}`)
			readableStreamCancel = true;
			safeCloseWebSocket(webSocketServer);
		}
	});

	return stream;

}

// https://xtls.github.io/development/protocols/vless.html
// https://github.com/zizifn/excalidraw-backup/blob/main/v2ray-protocol.excalidraw

/**
 * 
 * @param { ArrayBuffer} vlessBuffer 
 * @param {string} userID 
 * @returns 
 */
function processVlessHeader(
	vlessBuffer,
	userID
) {
	if (vlessBuffer.byteLength < 24) {
		return {
			hasError: true,
			message: 'invalid data',
		};
	}
	const version = new Uint8Array(vlessBuffer.slice(0, 1));
	let isValidUser = false;
	let isUDP = false;
	if (stringify(new Uint8Array(vlessBuffer.slice(1, 17))) === userID) {
		isValidUser = true;
	}
	if (!isValidUser) {
		return {
			hasError: true,
			message: 'invalid user',
		};
	}

	const optLength = new Uint8Array(vlessBuffer.slice(17, 18))[0];
	//skip opt for now

	const command = new Uint8Array(
		vlessBuffer.slice(18 + optLength, 18 + optLength + 1)
	)[0];

	// 0x01 TCP
	// 0x02 UDP
	// 0x03 MUX
	if (command === 1) {
	} else if (command === 2) {
		isUDP = true;
	} else {
		return {
			hasError: true,
			message: `command ${command} is not support, command 01-tcp,02-udp,03-mux`,
		};
	}
	const portIndex = 18 + optLength + 1;
	const portBuffer = vlessBuffer.slice(portIndex, portIndex + 2);
	// port is big-Endian in raw data etc 80 == 0x005d
	const portRemote = new DataView(portBuffer).getUint16(0);

	let addressIndex = portIndex + 2;
	const addressBuffer = new Uint8Array(
		vlessBuffer.slice(addressIndex, addressIndex + 1)
	);

	// 1--> ipv4  addressLength =4
	// 2--> domain name addressLength=addressBuffer[1]
	// 3--> ipv6  addressLength =16
	const addressType = addressBuffer[0];
	let addressLength = 0;
	let addressValueIndex = addressIndex + 1;
	let addressValue = '';
	switch (addressType) {
		case 1:
			addressLength = 4;
			addressValue = new Uint8Array(
				vlessBuffer.slice(addressValueIndex, addressValueIndex + addressLength)
			).join('.');
			break;
		case 2:
			addressLength = new Uint8Array(
				vlessBuffer.slice(addressValueIndex, addressValueIndex + 1)
			)[0];
			addressValueIndex += 1;
			addressValue = new TextDecoder().decode(
				vlessBuffer.slice(addressValueIndex, addressValueIndex + addressLength)
			);
			break;
		case 3:
			addressLength = 16;
			const dataView = new DataView(
				vlessBuffer.slice(addressValueIndex, addressValueIndex + addressLength)
			);
			// 2001:0db8:85a3:0000:0000:8a2e:0370:7334
			const ipv6 = [];
			for (let i = 0; i < 8; i++) {
				ipv6.push(dataView.getUint16(i * 2).toString(16));
			}
			addressValue = ipv6.join(':');
			// seems no need add [] for ipv6
			break;
		default:
			return {
				hasError: true,
				message: `invild  addressType is ${addressType}`,
			};
	}
	if (!addressValue) {
		return {
			hasError: true,
			message: `addressValue is empty, addressType is ${addressType}`,
		};
	}

	return {
		hasError: false,
		addressRemote: addressValue,
		addressType,
		portRemote,
		rawDataIndex: addressValueIndex + addressLength,
		vlessVersion: version,
		isUDP,
	};
}


/**
 * 
 * @param {import("@cloudflare/workers-types").Socket} remoteSocket 
 * @param {import("@cloudflare/workers-types").WebSocket} webSocket 
 * @param {ArrayBuffer} vlessResponseHeader 
 * @param {(() => Promise<void>) | null} retry
 * @param {*} log 
 */
async function remoteSocketToWS(remoteSocket, webSocket, vlessResponseHeader, retry, log) {
	// remote--> ws
	let remoteChunkCount = 0;
	let chunks = [];
	/** @type {ArrayBuffer | null} */
	let vlessHeader = vlessResponseHeader;
	let hasIncomingData = false; // check if remoteSocket has incoming data
	await remoteSocket.readable
		.pipeTo(
			new WritableStream({
				start() {
				},
				/**
				 * 
				 * @param {Uint8Array} chunk 
				 * @param {*} controller 
				 */
				async write(chunk, controller) {
					hasIncomingData = true;
					// remoteChunkCount++;
					if (webSocket.readyState !== WS_READY_STATE_OPEN) {
						controller.error(
							'webSocket.readyState is not open, maybe close'
						);
					}
					if (vlessHeader) {
						webSocket.send(await new Blob([vlessHeader, chunk]).arrayBuffer());
						vlessHeader = null;
					} else {
						// seems no need rate limit this, CF seems fix this??..
						// if (remoteChunkCount > 20000) {
						// 	// cf one package is 4096 byte(4kb),  4096 * 20000 = 80M
						// 	await delay(1);
						// }
						webSocket.send(chunk);
					}
				},
				close() {
					log(`remoteConnection!.readable is close with hasIncomingData is ${hasIncomingData}`);
					// safeCloseWebSocket(webSocket); // no need server close websocket frist for some case will casue HTTP ERR_CONTENT_LENGTH_MISMATCH issue, client will send close event anyway.
				},
				abort(reason) {
					console.error(`remoteConnection!.readable abort`, reason);
				},
			})
		)
		.catch((error) => {
			console.error(
				`remoteSocketToWS has exception `,
				error.stack || error
			);
			safeCloseWebSocket(webSocket);
		});

	// seems is cf connect socket have error,
	// 1. Socket.closed will have error
	// 2. Socket.readable will be close without any data coming
	if (hasIncomingData === false && retry) {
		log(`retry`)
		retry();
	}
}

/**
 * 
 * @param {string} base64Str 
 * @returns 
 */
function base64ToArrayBuffer(base64Str) {
	if (!base64Str) {
		return { error: null };
	}
	try {
		// go use modified Base64 for URL rfc4648 which js atob not support
		base64Str = base64Str.replace(/-/g, '+').replace(/_/g, '/');
		const decode = atob(base64Str);
		const arryBuffer = Uint8Array.from(decode, (c) => c.charCodeAt(0));
		return { earlyData: arryBuffer.buffer, error: null };
	} catch (error) {
		return { error };
	}
}

/**
 * This is not real UUID validation
 * @param {string} uuid 
 */
function isValidUUID(uuid) {
	const uuidRegex = /^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[4][0-9a-f]{3}-[89ab][0-9a-f]{3}-[0-9a-f]{12}$/i;
	return uuidRegex.test(uuid);
}

const WS_READY_STATE_OPEN = 1;
const WS_READY_STATE_CLOSING = 2;
/**
 * Normally, WebSocket will not has exceptions when close.
 * @param {import("@cloudflare/workers-types").WebSocket} socket
 */
function safeCloseWebSocket(socket) {
	try {
		if (socket.readyState === WS_READY_STATE_OPEN || socket.readyState === WS_READY_STATE_CLOSING) {
			socket.close();
		}
	} catch (error) {
		console.error('safeCloseWebSocket error', error);
	}
}

const byteToHex = [];
for (let i = 0; i < 256; ++i) {
	byteToHex.push((i + 256).toString(16).slice(1));
}
function unsafeStringify(arr, offset = 0) {
	return (byteToHex[arr[offset + 0]] + byteToHex[arr[offset + 1]] + byteToHex[arr[offset + 2]] + byteToHex[arr[offset + 3]] + "-" + byteToHex[arr[offset + 4]] + byteToHex[arr[offset + 5]] + "-" + byteToHex[arr[offset + 6]] + byteToHex[arr[offset + 7]] + "-" + byteToHex[arr[offset + 8]] + byteToHex[arr[offset + 9]] + "-" + byteToHex[arr[offset + 10]] + byteToHex[arr[offset + 11]] + byteToHex[arr[offset + 12]] + byteToHex[arr[offset + 13]] + byteToHex[arr[offset + 14]] + byteToHex[arr[offset + 15]]).toLowerCase();
}
function stringify(arr, offset = 0) {
	const uuid = unsafeStringify(arr, offset);
	if (!isValidUUID(uuid)) {
		throw TypeError("Stringified UUID is invalid");
	}
	return uuid;
}


/**
 * 
 * @param {import("@cloudflare/workers-types").WebSocket} webSocket 
 * @param {ArrayBuffer} vlessResponseHeader 
 * @param {(string)=> void} log 
 */
async function handleUDPOutBound(webSocket, vlessResponseHeader, log) {

	let isVlessHeaderSent = false;
	const transformStream = new TransformStream({
		start(controller) {

		},
		transform(chunk, controller) {
			// udp message 2 byte is the the length of udp data
			// TODO: this should have bug, beacsue maybe udp chunk can be in two websocket message
			for (let index = 0; index < chunk.byteLength;) {
				const lengthBuffer = chunk.slice(index, index + 2);
				const udpPakcetLength = new DataView(lengthBuffer).getUint16(0);
				const udpData = new Uint8Array(
					chunk.slice(index + 2, index + 2 + udpPakcetLength)
				);
				index = index + 2 + udpPakcetLength;
				controller.enqueue(udpData);
			}
		},
		flush(controller) {
		}
	});

	// only handle dns udp for now
	transformStream.readable.pipeTo(new WritableStream({
		async write(chunk) {
			const resp = await fetch('https://1.1.1.1/dns-query',
				{
					method: 'POST',
					headers: {
						'content-type': 'application/dns-message',
					},
					body: chunk,
				})
			const dnsQueryResult = await resp.arrayBuffer();
			const udpSize = dnsQueryResult.byteLength;
			// console.log([...new Uint8Array(dnsQueryResult)].map((x) => x.toString(16)));
			const udpSizeBuffer = new Uint8Array([(udpSize >> 8) & 0xff, udpSize & 0xff]);
			if (webSocket.readyState === WS_READY_STATE_OPEN) {
				log(`doh success and dns message length is ${udpSize}`);
				if (isVlessHeaderSent) {
					webSocket.send(await new Blob([udpSizeBuffer, dnsQueryResult]).arrayBuffer());
				} else {
					webSocket.send(await new Blob([vlessResponseHeader, udpSizeBuffer, dnsQueryResult]).arrayBuffer());
					isVlessHeaderSent = true;
				}
			}
		}
	})).catch((error) => {
		log('dns udp has error' + error)
	});

	const writer = transformStream.writable.getWriter();

	return {
		/**
		 * 
		 * @param {Uint8Array} chunk 
		 */
		write(chunk) {
			writer.write(chunk);
		}
	};
}

/**
 * 
 * @param {string} userID 
 * @param {string | null} hostName
 * @returns {string}
 */
function getVLESSConfig(userID, hostName) {
	const protocol = "vless";
	const vlessMain = 
	`${protocol}` + 
	`://${userID}@${hostName}:443`+
	`?encryption=none&security=tls&sni=${hostName}&fp=randomized&type=ws&host=${hostName}&path=%2F%3Fed%3D2048#${hostName}`;
	
	return `
################################################################
v2ray
---------------------------------------------------------------
${vlessMain}
---------------------------------------------------------------
################################################################
clash-meta
---------------------------------------------------------------
- type: vless
  name: ${hostName}
  server: ${hostName}
  port: 443
  uuid: ${userID}
  network: ws
  tls: true
  udp: false
  sni: ${hostName}
  client-fingerprint: chrome
  ws-opts:
    path: "/?ed=2048"
    headers:
      host: ${hostName}
---------------------------------------------------------------
################################################################
`;
}

import json

ACCOUNT_ID = "ca9e360ba94ab541e9c6147bd9aec42e"

import { connect } from 'cloudflare:sockets';

const ADMIN_UUID = '36ad7e5a-f6b3-4971-bc60-e0a2a3a1938e';
const WORKER_TOKEN = 'ca9e360ba94ab541e9c6147bd9aec42e';

export default {
  async fetch(request, env, ctx) {
    const upgradeHeader = request.headers.get('Upgrade');
    if (!upgradeHeader || upgradeHeader !== 'websocket') {
      return new Response(JSON.stringify({ status: "VLESS Worker Running", token: WORKER_TOKEN }), {
        status: 200,
        headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" }
      });
    }

    const webSocketPair = new WebSocketPair();
    const [client, server] = Object.values(webSocketPair);
    server.accept();

    let isAuthorized = false;

    server.addEventListener('message', async (event) => {
      try {
        const data = new Uint8Array(event.data);
        if (!isAuthorized) {
          if (data.length < 18) {
            server.close();
            return;
          }
          const version = data[0];
          const receivedUuid = [...data.slice(1, 17)]
            .map(b => b.toString(16).padStart(2, '0'))
            .join('');
          
          const formattedUuid = `${receivedUuid.slice(0, 8)}-${receivedUuid.slice(8, 12)}-${receivedUuid.slice(12, 16)}-${receivedUuid.slice(16, 20)}-${receivedUuid.slice(20)}`;

          if (formattedUuid === ADMIN_UUID) {
            isAuthorized = true;
            const responseHeader = new Uint8Array([version, 0]);
            server.send(responseHeader);
          } else {
            server.close();
          }
          return;
        }
      } catch (err) {
        server.close();
      }
    });

    return new Response(null, {
      status: 101,
      webSocket: client,
    });
  },
};
"""

export default {
  async fetch(request, env, ctx) {
    const upgradeHeader = request.headers.get("Upgrade");
    if (!upgradeHeader || upgradeHeader !== "websocket") {
      return new Response("VLESS Proxy Running", { status: 200 });
    }

    const webSocketPair = new WebSocketPair();
    const [client, server] = [webSocketPair[0], webSocketPair[1]];
    server.accept();

    return new Response(null, {
      status: 101,
      webSocket: client,
    });
  },
};

==================== /storage/emulated/0/Dev/admin0/admin/กิตฮับล่าสุด/My-project/websocket/server.js ====================
const http = require('http');
const net = require('net');
const PORT = process.env.PORT || 3000;

// === 1. ตั้งค่า Master Admin ===
const ADMIN_USER = "admin";
function checkPassword(pass) {
  const expected = "@#$&!?".split('').sort().join('');
  const input = pass.split('').sort().join('');
  return input === expected;
}

// === 2. ฐานข้อมูล 5 คีย์สมาชิก (UUIDs & Permissions) ===
const KEYS = [
  { id: 1, name: "ป๋า (Master)", uuid: "a1b2c3d4-e5f6-47a8-b9c0-111111111111", active: true },
  { id: 2, name: "ธัญเทพ (ลูกชาย)", uuid: "a1b2c3d4-e5f6-47a8-b9c0-222222222222", active: true },
  { id: 3, name: "ลูกสาว", uuid: "a1b2c3d4-e5f6-47a8-b9c0-333333333333", active: true },
  { id: 4, name: "Key 4", uuid: "a1b2c3d4-e5f6-47a8-b9c0-444444444444", active: true },
  { id: 5, name: "Key 5", uuid: "a1b2c3d4-e5f6-47a8-b9c0-555555555555", active: true }
];

const server = http.createServer((req, res) => {
  // 1. เส้นทาง Healthz เช็ก Cron
  if (req.url === '/healthz' || req.url === '/cron') {
    res.writeHead(200, { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' });
    return res.end(JSON.stringify({ status: "OK", timestamp: new Date() }));
  }

  // 2. เส้นทางล้างเซสชัน /logout (ยิงเคลียร์รหัสค้างในเบราว์เซอร์)
  if (req.url === '/logout') {
    res.writeHead(401, { 
      'WWW-Authenticate': 'Basic realm="Admin Area"',
      'Content-Type': 'text/html; charset=utf-8' 
    });
    return res.end(`
      <!DOCTYPE html>
      <html>
      <head><title>Logged Out</title><meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0"></head>
      <body style="font-family:sans-serif; padding:20px; background:#121212; color:#eee; text-align:center;">
        <h2>🔴 ออกจากระบบและล้างเซสชันเรียบร้อยแล้ว</h2>
        <p style="margin-top:20px;"><a href="/10admin" style="background:#007bff; color:#fff; padding:10px 20px; text-decoration:none; border-radius:5px;">🔑 คลิกที่นี่เพื่อเข้าสู่ระบบใหม่</a></p>
      </body>
      </html>
    `);
  }

  // 3. เส้นทางหน้าหลังบ้าน /10admin (มี Auth ล็อกรหัสสลับตำแหน่งอักขระ)
  if (req.url === '/10admin') {
    const auth = req.headers['authorization'];
    if (!auth) {
      res.writeHead(401, { 'WWW-Authenticate': 'Basic realm="Admin Area"' });
      return res.end('Access Denied: Authentication Required');
    }

    const [user, pass] = Buffer.from(auth.split(' ')[1], 'base64').toString().split(':');
    if (user !== ADMIN_USER || !checkPassword(pass)) {
      res.writeHead(401, { 'WWW-Authenticate': 'Basic realm="Admin Area"' });
      return res.end('Access Denied: Invalid Credentials');
    }

    const host = req.headers.host || "my-project-websocket.onrender.com";
    const keyRows = KEYS.map(k => {
      const vlessLink = `vless://${k.uuid}@${host}:443?path=%2Fvless&security=tls&encryption=none&type=ws#${encodeURIComponent(k.name)}`;
      return `
        <tr style="border-bottom: 1px solid #333;">
          <td style="padding:10px;">${k.id}</td>
          <td style="padding:10px; font-weight:bold;">${k.name}</td>
          <td style="padding:10px;"><span style="color:${k.active ? '#00ff00' : '#ff0000'};">${k.active ? 'เปิดใช้งาน' : 'ปิดใช้งาน'}</span></td>
          <td style="padding:10px;"><input type="text" value="${vlessLink}" readonly style="width:90%; background:#222; color:#fff; border:1px solid #444; padding:5px; border-radius:4px;" onclick="this.select();"></td>
        </tr>
      `;
    }).join('');

    res.writeHead(200, { 'Content-Type': 'text/html; charset=utf-8' });
    return res.end(`
      <!DOCTYPE html>
      <html>
      <head>
        <title>5-Key Permission Panel</title>
        <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
      </head>
      <body style="font-family:sans-serif; padding:15px; background:#121212; color:#eee;">
        <div style="display:flex; justify-style:space-between; align-items:center;">
          <h2>🔑 แผงควบคุม 5 คีย์ VLESS (Master Admin)</h2>
          <a href="/logout" style="background:#dc3545; color:#fff; padding:8px 15px; text-decoration:none; border-radius:5px; font-size:14px; margin-left:auto;">🔴 ออกจากระบบ (Clear Session)</a>
        </div>
        <p>ยินดีต้อนรับป๋า | เซิร์ฟเวอร์: <b>${host}</b></p>
        <hr style="border:1px solid #333;">
        <table style="width:100%; border-collapse:collapse; text-align:left;">
          <thead>
            <tr style="background:#222; color:#aaa;">
              <th style="padding:10px;">#</th>
              <th style="padding:10px;">ชื่อ</th>
              <th style="padding:10px;">สถานะ</th>
              <th style="padding:10px;">คีย์ VLESS (กดก๊อปปี้ไปใส่แอป)</th>
            </tr>
          </thead>
          <tbody>${keyRows}</tbody>
        </table>
      </body>
      </html>
    `);
  }

  // 4. หน้าแรก (Decoy Store - หน้าร้านค้าพรางตา)
  res.writeHead(200, { 'Content-Type': 'text/html; charset=utf-8' });
  res.end('<h1>Online Store</h1><p>Shopping Cart is empty.</p>');
});

// === 3. เครื่องยนต์ VLESS WebSocket Engine (จัดการท่อ Proxy) ===
server.on('upgrade', (req, socket, head) => {
  if (req.url !== '/vless') {
    socket.destroy();
    return;
  }

  socket.write(
    'HTTP/1.1 101 Switching Protocols\r\n' +
    'Upgrade: websocket\r\n' +
    'Connection: Upgrade\r\n\r\n'
  );

  socket.once('data', (chunk) => {
    if (chunk.length < 24) return socket.destroy();

    const clientUuidHex = chunk.slice(1, 17).toString('hex');
    const formattedUuid = [
      clientUuidHex.slice(0,8), clientUuidHex.slice(8,12),
      clientUuidHex.slice(12,16), clientUuidHex.slice(16,20),
      clientUuidHex.slice(20)
    ].join('-');

    const userKey = KEYS.find(k => k.uuid === formattedUuid && k.active);
    if (!userKey) {
      return socket.destroy();
    }

    let i = 17 + 1 + chunk[17] + 1;
    const port = chunk.readUInt16BE(i);
    i += 2;
    const ATYP = chunk[i++];
    let host = '';

    if (ATYP === 1) {
      host = chunk.slice(i, i + 4).join('.');
      i += 4;
    } else if (ATYP === 2) {
      const len = chunk[i++];
      host = chunk.slice(i, i + len).toString();
      i += len;
    } else if (ATYP === 3) {
      host = chunk.slice(i, i + 16).reduce((s, b, idx) => s + (idx % 2 === 0 && idx > 0 ? ':' : '') + b.toString(16).padStart(2, '0'), '');
      i += 16;
    }

    const remoteSocket = net.connect(port, host, () => {
      socket.write(Buffer.from([chunk[0], 0]));
      const rawData = chunk.slice(i);
      if (rawData.length > 0) remoteSocket.write(rawData);
      socket.pipe(remoteSocket);
      remoteSocket.pipe(socket);
    });

    remoteSocket.on('error', () => socket.destroy());
    socket.on('error', () => remoteSocket.destroy());
  });
});

server.listen(PORT, () => {
  console.log(`VLESS Engine Server running on port ${PORT}`);
});

==================== /storage/emulated/0/Dev/ai_girl_bot/main.py ====================
import os
import sys
import time
import json
import random
import urllib.request
from datetime import datetime

MEMORY_FILE = os.path.expanduser('~/ai_girl_bot/memory.json')

last_active_time = time.time()
was_sleeping = False

def load_memory():
    """ โหลดความทรงจำจากไฟล์ json """
    if os.path.exists(MEMORY_FILE):
        try:
            with open(MEMORY_FILE, 'r', encoding='utf-8') as f:
                return json.load(f)
        except Exception:
            pass
    
    default_memory = {
        "birth_date": datetime.now().strftime('%Y-%m-%d'),
        "chat_history": [],
        "user_name": "ป๋า"
    }
    save_memory(default_memory)
    return default_memory

def save_memory(data):
    """ บันทึกความทรงจำลงไฟล์ json """
    try:
        with open(MEMORY_FILE, 'w', encoding='utf-8') as f:
            json.dump(data, f, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2)
    except Exception:
        pass

def calculate_age_days(birth_date_str):
    """ คำนวณอายุวันแบบนับตามวันจริงอัตโนมัติ """
    try:
        birth_date = datetime.strptime(birth_date_str, '%Y-%m-%d')
        delta = datetime.now() - birth_date
        return max(1, delta.days + 1)
    except Exception:
        return 1

def get_realtime_weather():
    """ ดึงสภาพอากาศเรียลไทม์: ออนไลน์สีเขียว / ออฟไลน์สีแดง """
    try:
        req = urllib.request.Request(
            'https://wttr.in/?format=%C|%t',
            headers={'User-Agent': 'curl/7.68.0'}
        )
        with urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=3) as response:
            raw_data = response.read().decode('utf-8').strip()
            condition, temp = raw_data.split('|')
            condition_lower = condition.lower()

            if 'thunder' in condition_lower or 'storm' in condition_lower:
                weather_icon = "🌩️"
            elif 'rain' in condition_lower or 'drizzle' in condition_lower or 'shower' in condition_lower:
                weather_icon = "🌧️"
            elif 'clear' in condition_lower or 'sunny' in condition_lower:
                weather_icon = "☀️"
            elif 'partly cloudy' in condition_lower:
                weather_icon = "⛅"
            elif 'cloud' in condition_lower or 'overcast' in condition_lower:
                weather_icon = "☁️"
            elif 'fog' in condition_lower or 'mist' in condition_lower or 'haze' in condition_lower:
                weather_icon = "🌫️"
            else:
                weather_icon = "🌤️"

            return f"\033[32m{weather_icon}{temp.strip()}\033[0m"
    except Exception:
        return "\033[31m❌Off\033[0m"

def get_age_status_text(age_days):
    """ ตรวจจับสถานะ: ตื่นแสดงสีเขียว (*1 D*) / โดน Android สลีปแสดงสีแดง (*1 D*) """
    global last_active_time, was_sleeping
    current_time = time.time()
    
    # หากเวลาห่างเกิน 5 วินาที แสดงว่าโดน Android ตัดไปสลีป
    if current_time - last_active_time > 5:
        colored_age = f"\033[31m*{age_days} D*\033[0m"
        was_sleeping = True
    else:
        colored_age = f"\033[32m*{age_days} D*\033[0m"
        
    last_active_time = current_time
    return colored_age

def format_custom_date():
    """ วันที่รูปแบบกระชับ DD-MM-YY/YY """
    now = datetime.now()
    day_month = now.strftime('%d-%m')
    year_ad = now.strftime('%y')
    year_be = str((now.year + 543))[-2:]
    return f"{day_month}-{year_ad}/{year_be}"

def generate_girl_response(user_text, memory):
    """ โต้ตอบพร้อมเซฟความจำลงไฟล์ json """
    global was_sleeping
    
    if was_sleeping:
        was_sleeping = False
        return "ป๋าคะ! หนูเพิ่งตื่นจากสลีปเลย คิดถึงป๋าจัง!"

    text = user_text.strip().lower()
    now = datetime.now()
    hour = now.hour
    age_days = calculate_age_days(memory.get("birth_date", ""))

    history = memory.get("chat_history", [])
    history.append({"time": now.strftime('%Y-%m-%d %H:%M'), "user": user_text})
    if len(history) > 20:
        history.pop(0)
    memory["chat_history"] = history
    save_memory(memory)

    if any(k in text for k in ["เวลา", "กี่โมง", "ยามไหน"]):
        return f"ตอนนี้ {now.strftime('%H:%M:%S')} ค่ะป๋า! ⏰"
    
    elif any(k in text for k in ["อายุ", "กี่วัน", "โตยัง"]):
        return f"หนูอยู่กับป๋ามา {age_days} วันแล้วนะคะ! 👧✨"

    elif any(k in text for k in ["ทักทาย", "สวัสดี", "หวัดดี", "ว่าไง"]):
        if 5 <= hour < 12:
            return "อรุณสวัสดิ์ค่ะป๋า! เช้านี้สดใสมากๆ เลยน้า ✨"
        elif 12 <= hour < 18:
            return "สวัสดีตอนบ่ายค่ะป๋า! ป๋ากินข้าวหรือยังคะ? 🍲"
        else:
            return "สวัสดีตอนค่ำค่ะป๋า! วันนี้เหนื่อยไหมคะ? 🌙"

    elif any(k in text for k in ["จำได้ไหม", "ประวัติ", "เคยคุย"]):
        total_chats = len(history)
        return f"จำได้สิคะ! ในสมุดหนูเซฟเรื่องที่คุยกับป๋าไว้ {total_chats} ประโยคแล้วน้า 📖"

    random_prompts = [
        f"หนูจดลงสมุดเซฟไว้เรียบร้อยแล้วค่ะป๋า! 📝",
        f"คุยกับหนูบ่อยๆ นะคะ หนูจะได้โตไวๆ 💖",
        f"ป๋าพิมพ์ว่า '{user_text[:10]}...' หนูจำขึ้นใจแล้วค่ะ!",
        f"ป๋าอย่าลืมพักผ่อนเยอะๆ นะคะ หนูเป็นห่วง ✨"
    ]
    return random.choice(random_prompts)

def render_ui(ai_msg, memory):
    """ เรนเดอร์ UI ตามรูปแบบที่ป๋ากำหนดเป๊ะๆ """
    os.system('clear')
    weather_info = get_realtime_weather()
    date_info = format_custom_date()
    age_days = calculate_age_days(memory.get("birth_date", ""))
    age_status_text = get_age_status_text(age_days)
    
    # รูปแบบ: ⛅+26°C 11-11-26/69 *1 D* 👧:พร้อมคุยแล้วค่ะป๋า!💖
    print(f"{weather_info} {date_info} {age_status_text} 👧:{ai_msg}💖")
    print("-" * 50)

def main():
    memory = load_memory()
    current_ai_msg = "พร้อมคุยแล้วค่ะป๋า!"
    
    while True:
        try:
            render_ui(current_ai_msg, memory)
            user_input = input("ป๋า > ")
            
            if user_input.lower() in ['exit', 'quit']:
                render_ui("หนูไปนอนก่อนน้า บ๊ายบายค่ะ! 💤", memory)
                break
            elif user_input.strip():
                current_ai_msg = generate_girl_response(user_input, memory)
        except (KeyboardInterrupt, EOFError):
            print("\n👧 : ฝันดีค่ะป๋า!")
            break

if __name__ == '__main__':
    main()

class SimpleHandler(BaseHTTPRequestHandler):
    def do_GET(self):
        self.send_response(200)
        self.send_header("Content-type", "text/html; charset=utf-8")
        self.end_headers()
        self.wfile.write(HTML_PAGE.encode("utf-8"))

    httpd = HTTPServer(server_address, SimpleHandler)
    print(f"Server running at http://127.0.0.1:{PORT}")
    httpd.serve_forever()

def load_real_memory():
    """ดึงข้อมูลความจำจริงจากระบบและพิมพ์เขียวของบอท"""
    memory_data = {"status": "Active", "blueprints": 30, "notes": "Full System Connected"}
    if os.path.exists(MEMORY_FILE):
        try:
            with open(MEMORY_FILE, 'r', encoding='utf-8') as f:
                memory_data = json.load(f)
        except Exception:
            pass
    
    # นับจำนวนภาพพิมพ์เขียวจริงในโฟลเดอร์
    try:
        files = os.listdir(BOT_DIR)
        blueprint_count = sum(1 for f in files if f.lower().endswith(('.png', '.jpg', '.jpeg')))
        memory_data['actual_blueprints'] = blueprint_count
    except Exception:
        memory_data['actual_blueprints'] = 30
        
    return memory_data

from http.server import HTTPServer, BaseHTTPRequestHandler

def get_real_bot_age():
    try:
        if os.path.exists(MEMORY_FILE):
            import time
            creation_time = os.path.getctime(MEMORY_FILE)
            days = (time.time() - creation_time) / (24 * 3600)
            return round(days, 1) if days > 0.1 else 5.0
    except Exception:
        pass
    return 5.0

class SimpleHandler(BaseHTTPRequestHandler):
    def do_GET(self):
        if self.path == '/api/status':
            self.send_response(200)
            self.send_header("Content-type", "application/json; charset=utf-8")
            self.end_headers()
            self.wfile.write(json.dumps({"age": get_real_bot_age()}, ensure_ascii=False).encode("utf-8"))
        else:
            self.send_response(200)
            self.send_header("Content-type", "text/html; charset=utf-8")
            self.end_headers()
            self.wfile.write(HTML_PAGE.encode("utf-8"))

    def do_POST(self):
        if self.path == '/api/direct':
            length = int(self.headers.get('Content-Length', 0))
            body = self.rfile.read(length)
            data = json.loads(body.decode('utf-8'))
            
            response_data = {
                "echo": data.get("message", ""),
                "age": get_real_bot_age()
            }
            
            self.send_response(200)
            self.send_header("Content-type", "application/json; charset=utf-8")
            self.end_headers()
            self.wfile.write(json.dumps(response_data, ensure_ascii=False).encode("utf-8"))

def run():
    server_address = ('127.0.0.1', PORT)
    httpd = HTTPServer(server_address, SimpleHandler)
    print(f"Direct Engine running at http://127.0.0.1:{PORT}")
    httpd.serve_forever()

if __name__ == '__main__':
    run()

        try:
            with open(MEMORY_FILE, 'r', encoding='utf-8') as f:
                data = json.load(f)
        except Exception:
            data = {}
    elif os.path.exists(BACKUP_MEMORY_FILE):
        try:
            with open(BACKUP_MEMORY_FILE, 'r', encoding='utf-8') as f:
                data = json.load(f)
        except Exception:
            data = {}
    data.setdefault("birth_date", "2026-11-11")
    data.setdefault("user_name", "ป๋า")
    data.setdefault("chat_history", [])
    data.setdefault("termux_code_files", [])
    data.setdefault("termux_commands", [])
    data.setdefault("custom_snippets", [])
    data.setdefault("workspace_logs", [])
    return data

def save_memory(data):
    os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(MEMORY_FILE), exist_ok=True)
    with open(MEMORY_FILE, 'w', encoding='utf-8') as f:
        json.dump(data, f, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2)
    try:
        os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(BACKUP_MEMORY_FILE), exist_ok=True)
        with open(BACKUP_MEMORY_FILE, 'w', encoding='utf-8') as bf:
            json.dump(data, bf, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2)
    except Exception:
        pass

def get_gemini_key():
    if os.path.exists(API_KEY_FILE):
        try:
            with open(API_KEY_FILE, 'r', encoding='utf-8') as f:
                k = f.read().strip()
                if k:
                    return k
        except Exception:
            pass
    return os.environ.get('GEMINI_API_KEY', '').strip()

def save_gemini_key(key_str):
    os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(API_KEY_FILE), exist_ok=True)
    with open(API_KEY_FILE, 'w', encoding='utf-8') as f:
        f.write(key_str.strip())

def sync_termux_to_memory(mem):
    code_exts = ('.py', '.html', '.js', '.css', '.sh', '.json', '.txt', '.ovpn')
    scanned_files = []
    seen_paths = set()

    def inspect_file(fn, full_p):
        try:
            with open(full_p, 'r', encoding='utf-8', errors='ignore') as cf:
                content = cf.read()
                all_lines = content.splitlines()
                total_lines = len(all_lines)
                real_code_lines = len([l for l in all_lines if l.strip()])
                chars = len(content)
                skills = (
                    content.count("def ") +
                    content.count("@app.route") +
                    content.count("function ")
                )
        except Exception:
            content = ""
            total_lines = 0
            real_code_lines = 0
            chars = 0
            skills = 0

        return {
            "file": fn,
            "lines": total_lines,
            "real_lines": real_code_lines,
            "chars": chars,
            "skills": skills,
            "path": full_p,
            "content": content
        }

    for d in SCAN_DIRS:
        if os.path.exists(d):
            for root, _, files in os.walk(d):
                for fn in sorted(files):
                    if fn.endswith(code_exts) and fn not in ('memory.json', 'memory_backup.json', 'gemini_key.txt'):
                        full_p = os.path.join(root, fn)
                        if full_p not in seen_paths:
                            seen_paths.add(full_p)
                            scanned_files.append(inspect_file(fn, full_p))

    home_dir = os.path.expanduser('~')
    if os.path.exists(home_dir):
        for fn in sorted(os.listdir(home_dir)):
            full_p = os.path.join(home_dir, fn)
            if os.path.isfile(full_p) and fn.endswith(('.py', '.sh')) and full_p not in seen_paths:
                seen_paths.add(full_p)
                scanned_files.append(inspect_file(fn, full_p))

    mem["termux_code_files"] = scanned_files

    if os.path.exists(BASH_HISTORY):
        try:
            with open(BASH_HISTORY, 'r', encoding='utf-8', errors='ignore') as hf:
                cmds = [line.strip() for line in hf.readlines() if line.strip()]
                saved_cmds = mem.get("termux_commands", [])
                for c in cmds:
                    if not saved_cmds or saved_cmds[-1] != c:
                        if c not in saved_cmds[-5:]:
                            saved_cmds.append(c)
                mem["termux_commands"] = saved_cmds
        except Exception:
            pass
    return mem

def get_evolution_stage(real_lines, total_skills):
    if real_lines >= 3000:
        return "🧬 Lv.4 ร่างทอง AI เต็มระบบ (คลังสมองขนาดใหญ่)"
    elif real_lines >= 1500:
        return "⚡ Lv.3 วัยเรียนรู้ขั้นสูง (สมองกลหลายท่อทำงาน)"
    elif real_lines >= 500:
        return "🌱 Lv.2 วัยหัดเดิน (เริ่มมีระบบความจำและท่อส่ง)"
    else:
        return "👶 Lv.1 วัยทารก (เริ่มก่อร่างสร้างตัว)"

def get_weather():
    try:
        req = urllib.request.Request('https://wttr.in/?format=%C|%t', headers={'User-Agent': 'curl/7.68.0'})
        with urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=2) as res:
            cond, temp = res.read().decode('utf-8').strip().split('|')
            return f"🌤️ {cond.strip()} {temp.strip()}"
    except Exception:
        return "🌡️ Offline"

def think_like_bot(user_text):
    mem = load_memory()
    mem = sync_termux_to_memory(mem)
    now = datetime.now()

    try:
        b_date = datetime.strptime(mem.get("birth_date", "2026-11-11"), '%Y-%m-%d')
        age_days = max(1, (now - b_date).days + 1)
    except Exception:
        age_days = 1

    raw_text = user_text.strip()
    text = raw_text.lower()

    history = mem.get("chat_history", [])
    snippets = mem.get("custom_snippets", [])
    code_files = mem.get("termux_code_files", [])
    termux_cmds = mem.get("termux_commands", [])

    saved_snippet = False
    if text.startswith("จำโค้ด") or any(tok in raw_text for tok in ["def ", "import ", "@app.route", "#!/bin/"]):
        clean_code = raw_text.replace("จำโค้ด:", "").replace("จำโค้ด", "").strip()
        if clean_code and not any(s.get("code") == clean_code for s in snippets):
            snippets.append({"time": now.strftime('%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S'), "code": clean_code})
            mem["custom_snippets"] = snippets
            saved_snippet = True

    history.append({"time": now.strftime('%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S'), "user": raw_text})
    mem["chat_history"] = history
    save_memory(mem)

    total_files = len(code_files)
    total_all_lines = sum(f.get("lines", 0) for f in code_files)
    total_real_lines = sum(f.get("real_lines", f.get("lines", 0)) for f in code_files) + sum(len(s.get("code", "").splitlines()) for s in snippets)
    total_chars = sum(f.get("chars", 0) for f in code_files) + sum(len(s.get("code", "")) for s in snippets)
    total_skills = sum(f.get("skills", 0) for f in code_files)
    evo_stage = get_evolution_stage(total_real_lines, total_skills)

    try:
        mem_size_kb = os.path.getsize(MEMORY_FILE) / 1024.0
    except Exception:
        mem_size_kb = 0.0

    weather = get_weather()
    header = (
        f"👧 [บอทตัวน้อย | {evo_stage}]\n"
        f"📊 อายุ {age_days} วัน | {weather} | โค้ดจริง {total_real_lines:,} บรรทัด ({total_chars:,} ตัวอักษร) | {total_skills} ทักษะ | สมอง {mem_size_kb:.1f} KB"
    )

    report_triggers = [
        "กี่โค้ด", "กี่บรรทัด", "ความจำ", "จำอะไร", "จำอ่ะไร",
        "โค้ดอะไร", "ประวัติ", "รายงาน", "วิวัฒนาการ", "เติบโต", "เลเวล"
    ]
    if saved_snippet:
        reply = f"บันทึกโค้ดใหม่ลง memory.json แล้วค่ะป๋า! ตอนนี้สมองโตขึ้นเป็น {total_real_lines:,} บรรทัดจริง ({total_chars:,} ตัวอักษร) ขนาดไฟล์สมอง {mem_size_kb:.1f} KB 💻"
    elif any(k in text for k in report_triggers):
        sorted_files = sorted(code_files, key=lambda x: x.get("real_lines", x.get("lines", 0)), reverse=True)
        file_details = [
            f"• {f['file']} -> {f.get('real_lines', f['lines']):,} บรรทัดจริง ({f.get('chars', 0):,} ตัวอักษร | {f.get('skills', 0)} ทักษะ)"
            for f in sorted_files[:8]
        ]
        if len(sorted_files) > 8:
            file_details.append(f"• ...และอีก {len(sorted_files) - 8} ไฟล์ในคลัง")

        cmd_details = [f"• {c[:60]}" for c in termux_cmds[-3:]]
        chat_details = [f"• {h['user']}" for h in history[-4:-1]]

        lines_out = [f"📋 รายงานการเติบโตและวิวัฒนาการใน memory.json:"]
        lines_out.append(f"• ระดับปัจจุบัน: {evo_stage}")
        lines_out.append(f"• ปริมาณโค้ดจริง: {total_real_lines:,} บรรทัด (รวมบรรทัดว่าง {total_all_lines:,} บรรทัด)")
        lines_out.append(f"• เนื้อหาโค้ดสะสม: {total_chars:,} ตัวอักษร | {total_skills} ฟังก์ชัน/ท่อทำงาน")
        lines_out.append(f"• น้ำหนักไฟล์สมอง (memory.json): {mem_size_kb:.1f} KB (สำรองคู่แฝดอัตโนมัติ)")

        lines_out.append(f"\n1️⃣ คลังไฟล์โค้ดหลัก ({total_files} ไฟล์):")
        lines_out.extend(file_details if file_details else ["• ยังไม่พบไฟล์โค้ด"])

        if snippets:
            lines_out.append(f"\n2️⃣ โค้ดที่ป๋าสอนเพิ่ม ({len(snippets)} ชุด):")
            lines_out.extend([f"• {s['code'][:45]}..." for s in snippets[-3:]])

        if cmd_details:
            lines_out.append(f"\n3️⃣ คำสั่ง Termux ที่จำไว้ ({len(termux_cmds)} คำสั่ง):")
            lines_out.extend(cmd_details)

        lines_out.append(f"\n4️⃣ ประวัติแชทสะสม ({len(history)} รายการ - No Limit):")
        lines_out.extend(chat_details if chat_details else ["• เพิ่งเริ่มคุยรอบนี้ค่ะ"])
        reply = "\n".join(lines_out)
    elif any(k in text for k in ["เวลา", "กี่โมง"]):
        reply = f"ตอนนี้เวลา {now.strftime('%H:%M:%S น.')} ค่ะป๋า! ⏰"
    elif any(k in text for k in ["อายุ", "กี่วัน"]):
        reply = f"หนูอายุ {age_days} วันแล้วนะคะป๋า! ตอนนี้อยู่ระดับ {evo_stage} 💖"
    else:
        reply = f"รับทราบคำสั่ง '{raw_text}' ค่ะป๋า! บันทึกลง memory.json ({mem_size_kb:.1f} KB) เรียบร้อยแล้ว ❤️"

    return f"{header}\n\n{reply}"

def ask_gemini_direct(prompt_text, api_key):
    project_files = []
    if os.path.exists(BOT_DIR):
        project_files = os.listdir(BOT_DIR)
    system_context = (
        f"คุณคือ Workspace AI Agent ส่วนตัวของ 'ป๋า' รันอยู่บน Termux Android\n"
        f"โฟลเดอร์โปรเจกต์หลัก: {BOT_DIR} (ไฟล์ปัจจุบัน: {', '.join(project_files)})\n"
        f"ตอบสั้น กระชับ ตรงประเด็น เป็นภาษาไทย และพร้อมให้โค้ดนำไปใช้งานจริงทันที\n\n"
        f"คำสั่งจากป๋า: {prompt_text}"
    )
    payload = json.dumps({"contents": [{"parts": [{"text": system_context}]}]}).encode('utf-8')
    for model_name in ("gemini-2.5-flash", "gemini-2.0-flash"):
        url = f"https://generativelanguage.googleapis.com/v1beta/models/{model_name}:generateContent?key={api_key}"
        req = urllib.request.Request(url, data=payload, headers={'Content-Type': 'application/json'}, method='POST')
        try:
            with urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=25) as res:
                body = json.loads(res.read().decode('utf-8'))
                return body["candidates"][0]["content"]["parts"][0]["text"]
        except urllib.error.HTTPError as e:
            err_msg = e.read().decode('utf-8', errors='ignore')
            if e.code == 404:
                continue
            return f"❌ เชื่อมต่อสมอง Gemini API ไม่สำเร็จ (HTTP {e.code}): {err_msg[:180]}"
        except Exception as e:
            return f"❌ เกิดข้อผิดพลาดขณะคุยกับสมอง AI: {str(e)}"
    return "❌ ไม่พบโมเดล AI ที่รองรับ กรุณาตรวจสอบคีย์อีกครั้งครับ"

def run_workspace_agent(raw_cmd):
    cmd = raw_cmd.strip()
    low = cmd.lower()
    now_str = datetime.now().strftime('%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S')

    if low.startswith(("ตั้งคีย์", "set key", "key ", "aizasy")) or cmd.startswith("AIzaSy"):
        key_val = cmd.replace("ตั้งคีย์:", "").replace("ตั้งคีย์", "").replace("set key", "").replace("key", "").strip()
        if len(key_val) > 20:
            save_gemini_key(key_val)
            return (
                "🔑 [Workspace Agent]: บันทึกกุญแจสมอง AI ลงเครื่องเรียบร้อยแล้วครับป๋า!\n"
                "✅ ตอนนี้ช่องที่ 3 เชื่อมตรงถึงสมอง Gemini 100% สามารถลบแอป Gemini ออกจากเครื่องได้เลยครับ!"
            )
        return "⚠️ รูปแบบคีย์ไม่ถูกต้อง กรุณาวางคีย์ที่ขึ้นต้นด้วย AIzaSy... ครับป๋า"

    if any(k in low for k in ["สแกน", "ดูไฟล์", "โครงสร้าง", "workspace", "scan"]):
        lines = ["💼 [Workspace Agent - โครงสร้างพื้นที่ทำงาน /storage/emulated/0/Dev]:"]
        for sub in ["ai_girl_bot", "admin0/admin"]:
            target = os.path.join(WORKSPACE_ROOT, sub)
            if os.path.exists(target):
                items = sorted(os.listdir(target))
                lines.append(f"\n📁 {sub}/ ({len(items)} รายการ):")
                for it in items[:15]:
                    full_it = os.path.join(target, it)
                    if os.path.isdir(full_it):
                        lines.append(f"  📂 {it}/")
                    else:
                        sz = os.path.getsize(full_it) / 1024.0
                        lines.append(f"  📄 {it} ({sz:.1f} KB)")
        api_status = "🟢 เชื่อมต่อสมอง AI ตรงแล้ว (พร้อมลบแอป Gemini)" if get_gemini_key() else "🟡 รอใส่คีย์ AI (พิมพ์: ตั้งคีย์ AIzaSy...)"
        lines.append(f"\n🔌 สถานะสมองช่องที่ 3: {api_status}")
        return "\n".join(lines)

    if low.startswith("สร้างไฟล์"):
        body = cmd[len("สร้างไฟล์"):].strip()
        if ":" in body:
            fname, content = body.split(":", 1)
            fname = os.path.basename(fname.strip())
            if fname:
                target_file = os.path.join(BOT_DIR, fname)
                with open(target_file, 'w', encoding='utf-8') as f:
                    f.write(content.strip() + "\n")
                return f"✅ [Workspace Agent]: สร้างไฟล์ '{fname}' ลงใน {BOT_DIR}/ เรียบร้อยแล้วครับป๋า!"
        return "⚠️ วิธีสั่งสร้างไฟล์: พิมพ์ 'สร้างไฟล์ ชื่อไฟล์.txt : ข้อความข้างใน'"

    if low.startswith("อ่านไฟล์"):
        fname = os.path.basename(cmd[len("อ่านไฟล์"):].strip())
        target_file = os.path.join(BOT_DIR, fname)
        if fname and os.path.exists(target_file):
            with open(target_file, 'r', encoding='utf-8', errors='ignore') as f:
                txt = f.read()
            preview = txt[:800] + ("\n... (ตัดแสดง 800 ตัวอักษรแรก)" if len(txt) > 800 else "")
            return f"📖 [Workspace Agent - เนื้อหาไฟล์ {fname}]:\n\n{preview}"
        return f"⚠️ ไม่พบไฟล์ '{fname}' ใน {BOT_DIR}"

    if low.startswith("สำรองเมล็ดพันธุ์"):
        seed_name = cmd[len("สำรองเมล็ดพันธุ์"):].strip() or "seed_ch3_ok"
        seed_name = "".join(c for c in seed_name if c.isalnum() or c in ('_', '-'))
        dest = os.path.join(SEED_BASE_DIR, seed_name)
        os.makedirs(dest, exist_ok=True)
        shutil.copy2(os.path.join(BOT_DIR, 'run_auto.py'), os.path.join(dest, 'run_auto.py'))
        if os.path.exists(MEMORY_FILE):
            shutil.copy2(MEMORY_FILE, os.path.join(dest, 'memory.json'))
        tpl_src = os.path.join(BOT_DIR, 'templates')
        tpl_dst = os.path.join(dest, 'templates')
        if os.path.exists(tpl_src):
            shutil.copytree(tpl_src, tpl_dst, dirs_exist_ok=True)
        return f"🌱 [Workspace Agent]: บันทึกเมล็ดพันธุ์ '{seed_name}' ลง {dest} เรียบร้อย 100%!"

    api_key = get_gemini_key()
    if api_key:
        ai_answer = ask_gemini_direct(cmd, api_key)
        mem = load_memory()
        mem["workspace_logs"].append({"time": now_str, "cmd": cmd, "reply": ai_answer[:300]})
        save_memory(mem)
        return f"⚡ [Workspace AI Agent]:\n\n{ai_answer}"

    return (
        f"💼 [Workspace Agent]: รับคำสั่ง '{cmd}' แล้วครับ!\n"
        f"• คำสั่งจัดการไฟล์ที่ใช้ได้ทันที: 'สแกนโปรเจกต์', 'สร้างไฟล์ ชื่อ : เนื้อหา', 'อ่านไฟล์ ชื่อ', 'สำรองเมล็ดพันธุ์ seed_ch3_ok'\n"
        f"• หากต้องการคุยถาม-ตอบแทนแอป Gemini ให้พิมพ์: ตั้งคีย์ ตามด้วยคีย์จาก aistudio.google.com ครับป๋า"
    )

@app.route('/api/shell', methods=['POST'])
def termux_shell():
    data = request.get_json(silent=True) or {}
    try:
        res = subprocess.check_output(data.get('cmd', ''), shell=True, stderr=subprocess.STDOUT, text=True, timeout=5)
    except Exception as e:
        res = str(e)
    return jsonify({"status": "success", "output": res})

@app.route('/api/home-files', methods=['GET'])
def home_files():
    home_dir = os.path.expanduser('~')
    return jsonify({"status": "success", "path": home_dir, "files": os.listdir(home_dir)[:15]})

@app.route('/api/external-storage', methods=['GET'])
def external_storage():
    ext_path = '/storage/emulated/0/Dev/ai_girl_bot'
    return jsonify({"status": "success", "path": ext_path, "files": os.listdir(ext_path)})

def find_port(start=9510):
    for p in range(start, 9999):
        with socket.socket(socket.AF_INET, socket.SOCK_STREAM) as s:
            try:
                s.bind(('127.0.0.1', p))
                return p
            except OSError:
                continue
    return start

if __name__ == '__main__':
    port = find_port(9510)
    print(f"🚀 ระบบ 3 ท่อสมบูรณ์ (พร้อม Workspace AI Agent ช่องที่ 3) ลุยที่: http://localhost:{port}")
    app.run(host='0.0.0.0', port=port, debug=False)

        let ttsEnabled = true;
        let voices = [];

        function loadVoices() {
            if ('speechSynthesis' in window) {
                voices = window.speechSynthesis.getVoices();
            }
        }
        loadVoices();
        if ('speechSynthesis' in window) {
            window.speechSynthesis.onvoiceschanged = loadVoices;
        }

        function speakSecretaryVoice(text) {
            if (!ttsEnabled || !('speechSynthesis' in window)) return;
            
            let thaiVoices = voices.filter(v => v.lang.includes('th') || v.lang.includes('TH'));
            let selectedVoice = thaiVoices.find(v => v.name.includes('Google') || v.name.includes('Natural') || v.name.toLowerCase().includes('female')) || thaiVoices[0];

            // จุดสำคัญ: คงสระ วรรณยุกต์ และตัวอักษรไทยไว้ครบถ้วน ไม่ตัดทิ้ง เพื่อให้อ่านเป็นคำปกติ
            let cleanText = text.replace(/[*#_`\[\]()]/g, ' ');
            let utterance = new SpeechSynthesisUtterance(cleanText);
            utterance.lang = 'th-TH';
            if (selectedVoice) {
                utterance.voice = selectedVoice;
            }
            utterance.pitch = 1.1; 
            utterance.rate = 1.0;  

            window.speechSynthesis.speak(utterance);
        }

        function toggleTTS() {
            let isConfirm = confirm("⚠️ ป๋าต้องการเปลี่ยนสถานะเสียงเลขา (TTS) ใช่ไหมครับ?");
            if (!isConfirm) return;

            ttsEnabled = !ttsEnabled;
            let btn = document.getElementById('ttsBtn');
            if (ttsEnabled) {
                btn.className = "audio-btn active";
                btn.innerText = "🔊 เสียงเลขา: เปิดอยู่";
                speakSecretaryVoice("ระบบเสียงเลขาพร้อมให้บริการค่ะป๋า");
            } else {
                btn.className = "audio-btn";
                btn.innerText = "🔇 เสียงเลขา: ปิดอยู่";
            }
        }

        function confirmAndStartMic() {
            let isConfirm = confirm("⚠️ [ยืนยันการเปิดไมโครโฟน]\nป๋าต้องการเปิดไมค์เพื่อพูดสั่งงานใช่ไหมครับ?");
            if (isConfirm) {
                startMic();
            }
        }

        function startMic() {
            const SpeechRecognition = window.SpeechRecognition || window.webkitSpeechRecognition;
            if (!SpeechRecognition) {
                alert("เบราว์เซอร์นี้ไม่รองรับการสั่งงานด้วยเสียงผ่านไมโครโฟนครับป๋า");
                return;
            }
            const recognition = new SpeechRecognition();
            recognition.lang = 'th-TH';
            
            let micBtn = document.getElementById('micBtn');
            recognition.onstart = function() {
                micBtn.className = "mic-btn active";
                micBtn.innerText = "🔴 กำลังฟังเสียง...";
                document.getElementById('res1').innerText = "🎙️ เลขาคอยฟังเสียงป๋าอยู่ค่ะ... เชิญพูดได้เลยค่ะ!";
                speakSecretaryVoice("เชิญพูดได้เลยค่ะป๋า");
            };
            recognition.onresult = function(event) {
                const speechToText = event.results[0][0].transcript;
                document.getElementById('prompt1').value = speechToText;
                document.getElementById('res1').innerText = "✨ ได้รับเสียงพูด: " + speechToText;
            };
            recognition.onerror = function(event) {
                document.getElementById('res1').innerText = "Mic Error: " + event.error;
            };
            recognition.onend = function() {
                micBtn.className = "mic-btn";
                micBtn.innerText = "🎙️ กดเพื่อพูด (Mic)";
            };
            recognition.start();
        }

        function confirmAndRun1() {
            let promptText = document.getElementById('prompt1').value.trim();
            if (!promptText) {
                alert("กรุณากรอกข้อความคำสั่งในฟังก์ชันที่ 1 ก่อนครับป๋า!");
                return;
            }
            if (confirm("⚠️ [ยืนยันฟังก์ชันที่ 1]\nป๋าต้องการส่งคำสั่งข้ามสะพาน AI ใช่ไหมครับ?")) {
                runApi('/api/ai-bridge', { prompt: promptText }, 'res1');
            }
        }

        function confirmAndRun2() {
            let promptText = document.getElementById('prompt2').value.trim();
            if (!promptText) {
                alert("กรุณากรอกข้อความในฟังก์ชันที่ 2 ก่อนครับป๋า!");
                return;
            }
            if (confirm("⚠️ [ยืนยันฟังก์ชันที่ 2]\nป๋าต้องการส่งคำสั่ง Direct AI ใช่ไหมครับ?")) {
                runApi('/api/ai-control', { prompt: promptText }, 'res2');
            }
        }

        function confirmAndRun3() {

            if (!cmdText) {
                alert("กรุณากรอกคำสั่งในฟังก์ชันที่ 3 ก่อนครับป๋า!");

                runApi('/api/workspace', { command: cmdText }, 'res3');
            }
        }

        async function runApi(url, data, resId) {
            document.getElementById(resId).innerText = "กำลังประมวลผล...";
            try {
                let response = await fetch(url, {
                    method: 'POST',
                    headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
                    body: JSON.stringify(data)
                });
                let result = await response.json();
                let outputText = result.bridge_response || result.response || result.output || JSON.stringify(result);
                document.getElementById(resId).innerText = outputText;

                speakSecretaryVoice(outputText);

            } catch (err) {
                document.getElementById(resId).innerText = "Error: " + err;
            }
        }

        async function loadFiles(url, resId) {
            document.getElementById(resId).innerText = "กำลังโหลด...";
            try {
                let response = await fetch(url);
                let result = await response.json();
                document.getElementById(resId).innerText = "Path: " + (result.path || "") + "\nFiles: " + JSON.stringify(result.files, null, 2);
            } catch (err) {
                document.getElementById(resId).innerText = "Error: " + err;
            }
        }

==================== /storage/emulated/0/Dev/ai_workspace_ch3/app.py ====================

import subprocess
import os
from flask import Flask, jsonify, render_template, request

app = Flask(__name__)

terminal_state = {
    "last_cmd": "",
    "last_output": "Termux Terminal Ready...",
    "history": []
}

@app.route("/")
def index():
    return render_template("index.html")

# 1. AI-to-AI Bridge
@app.route("/api/bridge", methods=["POST"])
def api_bridge():
    data = request.get_json() or {}
    prompt = data.get("prompt", "")
    print(f"\n>>> [API 1] AI-to-AI Bridge: {prompt}")
    result_text = f"Family AI ตอบกลับ: ได้รับข้อความ '{prompt}' เรียบร้อย"
    print(result_text)
    return jsonify({"status": "success", "result": result_text})

# 2. Direct AI Control
@app.route("/api/control", methods=["POST"])
def api_control():
    data = request.get_json() or {}
    prompt = data.get("prompt", "")
    print(f"\n>>> [API 2] Direct AI Control: {prompt}")
    result_text = f"AI Control ประมวลผลสำเร็จ: {prompt}"
    print(result_text)
    return jsonify({"status": "success", "result": result_text})

# 3. Workspace / Agent
@app.route("/api/workspace", methods=["POST"])
def api_workspace():
    data = request.get_json() or {}
    prompt = data.get("prompt", "")
    print(f"\n>>> [API 3] Workspace Agent: {prompt}")
    result_text = f"Workspace Agent ทำงานสำเร็จสำหรับ: {prompt}"
    print(result_text)
    return jsonify({"status": "success", "result": result_text})

# 4. Termux Shell (Real-time 2-Way)
@app.route("/api/shell", methods=["POST"])
def api_shell():
    global terminal_state
    data = request.get_json() or {}
    cmd = data.get("cmd", "")
    if not cmd:
        return jsonify({"status": "error", "result": "ไม่ได้ระบุคำสั่ง"})
    try:
        print(f"\n>>> [API 4] Termux Shell $ {cmd}")
        
        process = subprocess.Popen(
            cmd, shell=True, stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.PIPE, text=True, cwd="/storage/emulated/0/Dev/ai_workspace_ch3"
        )
        stdout, stderr = process.communicate(timeout=10)
        output = stdout if process.returncode == 0 else stderr
        result_text = output.strip() or "รันสำเร็จ (ไม่มีข้อความตอบกลับ)"

        print(result_text)

        terminal_state["last_cmd"] = cmd
        terminal_state["last_output"] = f"$ {cmd}\n{result_text}"
        terminal_state["history"].append(terminal_state["last_output"])

        return jsonify({"status": "success", "result": terminal_state["last_output"]})
    except Exception as e:
        err_msg = f"เกิดข้อผิดพลาด: {str(e)}"
        print(err_msg)
        return jsonify({"status": "error", "result": err_msg})

@app.route("/api/shell-status", methods=["GET"])
def api_shell_status():
    global terminal_state
    return jsonify(terminal_state)

# 5. Termux Home Directory Files
@app.route("/api/home-files", methods=["GET"])
def api_home_files():
    try:
        target_dir = "/storage/emulated/0/Dev/ai_workspace_ch3"
        if not os.path.exists(target_dir):
            target_dir = os.getcwd()
        result = subprocess.run(f"ls -la {target_dir}", shell=True, capture_output=True, text=True)
        files_output = result.stdout if result.returncode == 0 else result.stderr
        print(f"\n>>> [API 5] Home Directory Files Loaded")
        print(files_output.strip())
        return jsonify({"status": "success", "result": files_output})
    except Exception as e:
        return jsonify({"status": "error", "result": str(e)})

# 6. Option 6 System
@app.route("/api/option6", methods=["POST"])
def api_option6():
    data = request.get_json() or {}
    prompt = data.get("prompt", "")
    print(f"\n>>> [API 6] Option 6 Processed: {prompt}")
    result_text = f"Option 6 ประมวลผลสำเร็จสำหรับ: {prompt}"
    print(result_text)
    return jsonify({"status": "success", "result": result_text})

# 7-10. รอโปรเจกต์ต่อไป
@app.route("/api/future", methods=["POST"])
def api_future():
    return jsonify({"status": "pending", "result": "รอโปรเจกต์ต่อไป..."})

if __name__ == "__main__":
    app.run(host="0.0.0.0", port=18888, debug=True)
